title: precheck warns of a check that reads its own item's brief or goal text for a literal its own source holds
goal: brief ID and goal ID echo the item's JSON and checks, so a check that splits the brief at '## Fixed rules' or picks the first line holding ' is done: ' matches the echo of its own source and fails on correct work: in SP-mujl7ebh TK-dcgp3kd2 check 0, ST-buzuumms check 1 and BG-i4fxvd2h's check and repro failed that way and the orchestrator rewrote them mid-sprint; precheck (or check) names such a check before the start gate, as it names a check that proves nothing.

run:
import json, re, shlex, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
live = json.load(open("backlog.json"))
(tmp / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items", "id_prefixes": live["id_prefixes"]}))
BL = str(Path("_tools/backlog.py").resolve())
def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
def bl(*a):
    return run(sys.executable, BL, "--root", str(tmp), *a)
run("git", "init", "-q")
run("git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@example.com", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "base")
bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "s", "--goal", "g")
sp = next((tmp / "items").glob("SP-*.json")).stem
bl("new", "story", "--title", "t", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "f.txt", "--sprint", sp, "--check", "python3 -c pass")
iid = [x.stem for x in (tmp / "items").glob("ST-*.json") if json.loads(x.read_text()).get("title") == "t"][0]
code = "import subprocess,sys;t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,\"_tools/backlog.py\",\"brief\",\"%s\"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;sys.exit(0 if \"x\" in t.split(\"## Fixed rules\")[1] else 1)" % iid
p = bl("set", iid, "--check", shlex.join(["python3", "-c", code]))
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
out = bl("precheck", sp)
text = (out.stdout + out.stderr).replace(code, "")
assert iid in text, text[-500:]
assert re.search(r"\bechoe?s?\b|its own (item|brief|goal|source)|own (brief|goal) text", text, re.I), "precheck says nothing of a check that reads its own item brief"

notes: SP-hlt2tdel close, 2026-10-14: again. ST-cr6lmafy's planned check 1 split the brief at '## Known failing' and '## Fixed rules' and matched its own echoed source, failing on correct work; the orchestrator rewrote it with newline-anchored markers on the worker's branch.
